title: Sparse-to-Sparse Feature Learning for Cross-Layer Analysis and Steering
abstract: arXiv:2611.33640v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding how models internally represent information is a central challenge in interpretation and control. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose dense hidden representations into sparse features, and cross-layer methods capture structure spanning multiple layers. However, existing objectives do not explicitly train the sparse code at one layer to predict the sparse code at the next layer. We propose sparse-to-sparse feature learning (S2S), where sparse features at each intermediate layer are trained to predict those of the immediately following layer, with the final layer anchored by an output-distribution loss and optimization proceeding sequentially from output to input. Experiments across eight language models show stronger adjacent-layer correspondence than matched sparse-feature baselines. We evaluate feature-based interventions at matched output-distribution shift, separating steering-induced effects from sparse-pathway reconst

translated_title: 面向跨层分析与引导的稀疏到稀疏特征学习
translated_abstract: 理解模型如何在内部表征信息是解释与控制领域的核心挑战。稀疏自编码器（SAEs）将稠密的隐藏表征分解为稀疏特征，而跨层方法能够捕获跨越多个层的结构。然而，现有的训练目标并未显式地训练某一层的稀疏编码去预测下一层的稀疏编码。我们提出稀疏到稀疏特征学习（S2S），其中每个中间层的稀疏特征被训练用于预测紧随其后的下一层的稀疏特征，最后一层由输出分布损失进行锚定，优化过程从输出到输入依次进行。在八个语言模型上的实验表明，与匹配的稀疏特征基线相比，该方法展现出更强的相邻层对应关系。我们在匹配的输出分布偏移条件下评估基于特征的干预，从而将引导引发的效果与稀疏通路的重构效应分离开来。
tldr: 提出稀疏到稀疏特征学习（S2S）方法，通过训练各层稀疏特征预测下一层的稀疏特征，在八个语言模型上实现了比现有基线更强的跨层特征对应关系，并能在控制输出分布偏移的条件下有效分析和引导模型行为。
en_tdlr: Proposes sparse-to-sparse feature learning (S2S), which trains sparse features at each layer to predict those of the next layer, achieving stronger adjacent-layer correspondence than existing sparse-feature baselines across eight language models and enabling feature-based steering analysis at matched output-distribution shift.
